content.short: Demex is an omni-chain DEX by Carbon Protocol combining spot trading, perpetuals, and an integrated money market for advanced DeFi strategies.
content.description: Demex is a comprehensive decentralized exchange built by the Carbon Protocol team that combines spot trading, perpetual futures, and a money market within a single omni-chain platform. The architecture allows users to trade assets from multiple blockchains while earning yield through integrated lending markets, with cross-margin functionality enabling sophisticated capital efficiency. Demex is deployed on Mantle offering deep liquidity, advanced order types, and a unified trading experience for experienced DeFi participants.
